# Cross-posting

**Does one cut go everywhere, or is each platform edited separately?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C33


## Master one, cross-post the rest
<a id="same-everywhere"></a>

Get good on one network (usually Instagram) and post the same file everywhere because it compounds.

**Looks like:** One reel goes to Instagram, Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn the same day with the same hook. It costs nothing extra.

**Good at:** speed; compounding reach; low effort

**Weak at:** hits a ceiling on each platform; watermarks or originality issues if exported badly

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals speed, reach · effort low

**How:** Export a clean master (no watermark) and upload it natively to each app.

**Backed by:** [Master one network, cross-post the rest](../topics/growth.md#growth-master-one-cross-post), [Specs: 9:16 reels, 4:5 or 3:4 feed](../topics/growth.md#growth-format-specs), [Native beats identical cross-posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-native-over-cross-post), [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Perfect is the enemy of posted](../topics/growth.md#growth-perfect-enemy-of-posted) · sources L07

## Native re-edit per platform
<a id="native-re-edit"></a>

Same footage; the meat stays and the hook changes per platform.

**Looks like:** The Instagram cut opens with a text hook, the Shorts cut opens on the action, and the TikTok cut is rawer. Same body, three openings.

**Good at:** higher ceiling per platform; tests hooks; same shoot, more chances

**Weak at:** more edit time; more files to manage

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short · niches all · goals reach, retention · effort medium

**How:** Keep the body as one sequence. Swap only the first 3–5 s per export in CapCut/ffmpeg.

**Backed by:** [Native beats identical cross-posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-native-over-cross-post), [TikTok: more candid, shot on iPhone](../topics/filming.md#film-tiktok-candid-iphone), [Carousel: hook on slides 1 and 2](../topics/hooks.md#hook-carousel-slides-1-2), [Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion) · sources L05, L07

## Waterfall one long piece
<a id="waterfall"></a>

Make one long piece and cut it into 10+ clips, carousels and posts.

**Looks like:** One YouTube video becomes six reels, two carousels, a quote card and a story series. Each piece links back to the long one.

**Good at:** efficiency; short form for awareness, long form for conversion; many posts from one shoot

**Weak at:** needs a long piece first; clips can lack context

**Best for:** formats yt-long, podcast, reel30, reel60, carousel · niches all · goals reach, sales, speed · effort high

**How:** Transcribe with faster-whisper, pick self-contained moments, and reframe to 9:16 with an OpenCV tracker.

**Backed by:** [Waterfall and repurpose winners](../topics/growth.md#growth-waterfall), [Short form = awareness, long = conversion](../topics/growth.md#growth-short-awareness-long-conversion), [Carousel: one image + 1–2 sentences](../topics/text.md#text-carousel-one-image), [3x3 wall of reels proves a trend](../topics/effects.md#l10-3x3-reel-wall), [Rahul: ~1 reel a day, two time slots](../topics/growth.md#growth-rahul-cadence) · sources L05

## One platform in focus at a time
<a id="one-platform-at-a-time"></a>

2–3 platforms, but resources go to one while the others sit in maintenance mode, then rotate.

**Looks like:** Instagram gets custom edits and daily replies; YouTube gets reposts only, until it is its turn.

**Good at:** focus; less spread thin; less single-platform risk

**Weak at:** the secondary platforms grow slowly; slow to build a second audience

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals follows, trust · effort low

**How:** Pick the focus platform for the quarter, and cross-post to the rest.

**Backed by:** [2–3 platforms, one at a time](../topics/growth.md#growth-two-three-platforms), [Master one network, cross-post the rest](../topics/growth.md#growth-master-one-cross-post), [Native beats identical cross-posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-native-over-cross-post), [Three Instagram strategies](../topics/brand.md#brand-instagram-strategies), [Community content: involve, converse, showcase](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-as-hero) · sources L05

## Mixing
Oren's own path mixes them: cross-post first, then build per-network strategies (level 2).

## Rule of thumb
Speed: same everywhere. Growth ceiling: native re-edit. Long-form makers: waterfall. Limited time: one platform at a time.
